### Biggest injury updates

- **Broncos DL Matt Henningsen** suffered a **torn Achilles** in practice and was carted off. It’s especially brutal because this comes **exactly one year after his previous Achilles tear**.  
  - **Why it matters:** Denver loses a camp standout who was having a strong training camp.

- **Broncos TE Nate Adkins** and **WR Marvin Mims Jr.** also **left practice with trainers**.  
  - **Status:** No diagnosis was specified.

- **Saints DT Bryan Bresee** was **officially placed on season-ending injured reserve** after tearing his ACL.  
  - **Why it matters:** New Orleans loses a young interior defender for the year.

- **Giants C John Michael Schmitz** is **likely headed to concussion protocol**, and **backup C Lucas Patrick** was **hobbling badly** in practice. The Giants are signing **C Brenden Jaimes** for depth.  
  - **Why it matters:** New York is patching up a thin center group fast.

### Returning from injury / rehab notes

- **Scharping** is being noted as a returning piece after **missing last season with a torn ACL**. He has guard/center versatility, which is relevant because the **Commanders are thin at center**.  
  - **Why it matters:** He could help Washington’s interior offensive line depth.

### What to watch next

- Whether **Adkins** or **Marvin Mims Jr.** miss additional practice time.
- How the **Giants** handle center if **Schmitz** enters protocol and **Patrick** can’t go.
- Whether **Henningsen’s** Achilles injury alters Denver’s defensive line rotation.
